senses.gloss:
ITA-1.9.3.3.16 smṛtiḥ स्मृतिः
Memory, recollection
The faculty of recollection, remembrance of things directly perceived or heard (scriptures) which results from a particular conjunction between soul and mind.

ITA-9.8.19 smṛtivardhakaḥ स्मृतिवर्धकः
Memory enhancer
Therapies or medicines beneficial for increasing memory power.
